```{r, message = F}
library(tidyverse)
library(cluster)
```

```{r}
bg  <- read_csv("/Users/kendra/Desktop/PSTAT-197A/Module-0-Team-5/module0-class-survey-team5/data/background-clean.csv")
int <- read_csv("/Users/kendra/Desktop/PSTAT-197A/Module-0-Team-5/module0-class-survey-team5/data/interest-clean.csv")

area_opts <- c("Analysis or classification of images",
               "Deep learning and neural networks",
               "Spatial statistics or time series analysis",
               "Data acquisition and engineering",
               "Natural language processing and analysis of text",
               "Model deployment and software or web integrations",
               "Data visualization and interactive dashboards",
               "Predictive modeling, generally",
               "Statistical models and inference, generally",
               "Databases", "Algorithms")

dat <- bg %>%
  inner_join(int, by = "response_id") %>%
  mutate(n_courses = str_count(courses, ",") + 1,
         n_areas   = map_int(areas, ~ sum(str_detect(.x, fixed(area_opts))))) %>%
  drop_na(prog.comf, math.comf, stat.comf, n_courses, n_areas)

X <- dat %>%
  select(prog.comf, math.comf, stat.comf, n_courses, n_areas) %>%
  scale()

# Choosing k: elbow and silhouette
set.seed(126)
k_vals <- 1:8
wss <- map_dbl(k_vals, ~ kmeans(X, centers = .x, nstart = 25)$tot.withinss)

d <- dist(X)
sil <- map_dbl(2:8, function(k) {
  km <- kmeans(X, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  mean(silhouette(km$cluster, d)[, "sil_width"])
})

k_df <- tibble(k = k_vals, wss = wss, sil = c(NA, sil))

ggplot(k_df, aes(k, wss)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_vals) +
  labs(title = "Elbow method", x = "Number of clusters (k)",
       y = "Total within-cluster sum of squares")

ggplot(filter(k_df, k >= 2), aes(k, sil)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2:8) +
  labs(title = "Silhouette method", x = "Number of clusters (k)",
       y = "Average silhouette width")

# Fit the final model
set.seed(126)
km <- kmeans(X, centers = 3, nstart = 25)   # change 3 to your chosen k
dat$cluster <- factor(km$cluster)

# Cluster plot: project onto the first two principal components 
pca <- prcomp(X)
pve <- round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2], 1)

as_tibble(pca$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(cluster = dat$cluster) %>%
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0.05, size = 2) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "norm", level = 0.68) +
  labs(title = "K-means clusters",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", pve[1], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", pve[2], "%)"))

# Profile each cluster on the original (unscaled) variables
dat %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(c(prog.comf, math.comf, stat.comf, n_courses, n_areas), mean),
            size = n())

# Do the profiles line up with project preference?
table(dat$cluster, dat$type)
```
